declarations.name: method_room
declarations.doc: The room the method still has, in the ratio.**

declarations.name: method_room_bracket
declarations.doc: It is positive and under four thousandths.

declarations.name: Method
declarations.doc: An assigned family label and rational exponent, with no analytic estimate attached.

declarations.name: halaszMethod
declarations.doc: Recorded multiplicative-labelled calibration with saving exponent zero.

declarations.name: lindelof_method_ceilings
declarations.doc: Capstone.** The three quantitative statements of the method-ceiling map, in one place. `(i)` the independent-signs model has resolution floor `1/8` at every index, and agrees with the conjectured truth exactly on `[1,2]`; `(ii)` a perfect `2j`-th moment beats an established exponent `θ` iff `j > 1/(2θ)`, and at `θ = 13/84` the sixth moment (`j = 3`) fails while the eighth (`j = 4`) succeeds; `(iii)` the transfer's two halves are each worth `1/8` alone and jointly worth `m(k) = 1`.

declarations.name: tendsto_of_tendsto_moments
declarations.doc: Method of moments.** Convergence of every moment to the moments of a measure with a factorial-geometric moment bound, along a sequence obeying that bound uniformly, is weak convergence.

declarations.name: purchase_width_cap
declarations.doc: Width cap of the pole-purchase method.** With pole coefficient `a₀ > 0`, aligned share coefficient `a₁ ≤ 2a₀`, total growth weight `S ≥ a₁`, height scale `L > 0`, and `η ≥ (3 − 2√2)/(2L)`, the purchase inequality `a₁/(δ+η) ≤ a₀/δ + L·S` holds for every `δ > 0`. The method therefore cannot exclude a zero at distance `η` from `Re s = 1`.

declarations.name: resonanceGain_tendsto_zero
declarations.doc: No resonance construction gives a power.** The maximal Gál-sum gain divided by any fixed power tends to zero, so the resonance method cannot produce `Ω(T^c)` for any `c > 0`, and hence no known method disproves the Lindelöf hypothesis.

declarations.name: FieldOneDoctrineAtlas
declarations.doc: Finite, method-neutral organizational atlas for the construction.

declarations.name: resonance_cannot_witness
declarations.doc: So the resonance method cannot witness positivity at any abscissa.**

declarations.name: FieldOneDoctrine
declarations.doc: Major doctrine families represented in the method-neutral field-one atlas.

declarations.name: escape_pos
declarations.doc: The escape value is positive: the method is not intrinsically capped.

declarations.name: frontierKnownLower
declarations.doc: The known lower bound's exponent — the resonance method contributes only a subpolynomial factor.

declarations.name: prolate_isPhaseOscillator
declarations.doc: The exact radial mode satisfies every hypothesis of the phase energy method.**

declarations.name: DifferentialIndependent.addUpperEndRatfunc
declarations.doc: Forward method form of two-way upper-end rational surgery invariance.

declarations.name: lindelof_collapses_to_crossover
declarations.doc: The single statement the architecture reduces to at its Lindelöf limit**: at the invariant crossover the target and the degenerate source coincide, so the method collapses to square-root cancellation, `S^6 ≤ M^3`, for a Dirichlet polynomial of length `T^(5/12)`.

declarations.name: minpoly_dvd_mahler
declarations.doc: Abstract Mahler divisibility (PROVED).** With a Mahler operator `τ` over `σ` and `τ φ = φ²`, the minimal polynomial of `φ` over `K` divides `(minpoly K φ).map σ ∘ (X²)` — the `σ`-twisted, `Y↦Y²`-substituted minimal polynomial — because `φ` is a root of it (`aeval_map_mahler` + `minpoly.aeval`). This is `P(z,Y) ∣ P(σz,Y²)` of the Mahler method, here as clean field theory.

declarations.name: volume_real_menonHarmonicBlockLarge_le_moment
declarations.doc: The moment method as a per-block measure bound.**

declarations.name: abs_osc_le
declarations.doc: The energy method gives the envelope.** The solution is bounded on `[a, ∞)` by the square root of its energy budget at `a`.

exploration.name: record_below_family
exploration.doc: The record lies strictly below the whole family**, which is why every improvement since Weyl has come from outside van der Corput's method.

exploration.name: logTangentDominated_cap
exploration.doc: One cap is log-tangent-dominated on its arc.** So the profile method of `ComplexPairArcCriterion` is the case `n = 1` of the piecewise criterion.

exploration.name: measureReal_annulusLarge_le
exploration.doc: The measure of the large half, by the moment method.** Each summand is what `Sieve/Section4RelativeThreshold.volume_blockExceptional_le_relative` controls.

exploration.name: fourthMomentPhaseExponent_two
exploration.doc: At `k = 2` the exponent is `1` — the method gives exactly nothing, as it must, since the stationary-phase mass and the trivial bound coincide there.

exploration.name: maximalWindowFirstMoment_moebius_of_rate
exploration.doc: The Möbius first moment, at the exact rate the method allows.** The admissible window laws are precisely those that dominate the Mertens supremum at the scale `3√x`.
